title: Naboo N-1 starfighter (Star Wars, The Phantom Menace)

sources.title: List of Star Wars starfighters: Naboo N-1 (Wikipedia)
Star Wars: Episode I - The Phantom Menace (Wikipedia)

intro: The N-1 is a fictional chrome-and-yellow fighter of the Royal Naboo Security Forces in The Phantom Menace. It has twin laser cannons, proton torpedoes, a socket for an astromech droid and an automatic pilot. The pilot sits alone under a bubble canopy at the front of the needle-shaped hull, with the droid behind.

areas.name: Canopy
areas.text: The bubble canopy over the seat.

panels.name: Canopy
panels.text: The clear bubble over the N-1 pilot's seat.
panels.context: It gives the pilot a view all around.

controls.name: Canopy
controls.text: A clear bubble over the single seat of the N-1.
controls.context: The bubble shape gives a wide view, useful in a dogfight.

areas.name: Instrument panel
areas.text: Displays and controls in front of the pilot.

panels.name: Instrument panel
panels.text: Screens, the automatic pilot control and the torpedo release in front of the pilot.
panels.context: In the film young Anakin is in this cockpit when the automatic pilot takes the fighter into a space battle.

controls.name: Forward displays
controls.text: Screens in front of the pilot show the sensor and targeting pictures.
controls.context: They help the pilot find and aim at enemy ships.

controls.name: Astromech message screen
controls.text: This screen shows the droid's messages as text, so the pilot can read what the droid says.
controls.context: R2-D2 talks to the pilot through it in the film.

controls.name: Autopilot control

positions.name: AUTO
positions.text: The automatic pilot flies the fighter.

positions.name: MANUAL
positions.text: The pilot flies the fighter by hand.

controls.text: This control switches the automatic pilot on or off. With it on the fighter flies by itself; with it off the pilot flies by hand.
controls.context: In the film the automatic pilot flies the fighter into the battle until Anakin takes over the controls.

controls.name: Torpedo release
controls.text: This control fires the proton torpedoes, the fighter's strongest weapons.
controls.context: In the film the torpedoes are fired inside the droid control ship and destroy it.

panels.name: Astromech socket
panels.text: A socket behind the cockpit for an astromech droid.
panels.context: The droid helps with navigation and repairs.

controls.name: Astromech droid (R2-D2)
controls.text: A small robot in the socket helps with navigation and repairs. In the film it is R2-D2.
controls.context: The droid fixes problems during the flight so the pilot can keep flying.

areas.name: Flight controls
areas.text: The hand controls the pilot flies with.

panels.name: Flight controls
panels.text: The hand controls in front of the pilot.
panels.context: They fly the fighter and fire the lasers.

controls.name: Flight controls
controls.text: The flight controls tip the nose up and down and roll the fighter left and right.
controls.context: They work once the automatic pilot is off.

controls.name: Fire control
controls.text: A control on the flight grips fires the twin laser cannons.
controls.context: The torpedoes have their own release; the lasers are for fighters and smaller targets.

panels.name: Throttle
panels.text: This stands for the control that sets the craft's speed.
panels.context: The Phantom Menace does not show this control clearly; the catalog adds it so a joystick set has a place for the speed.

controls.name: Throttle (not clearly shown)
controls.text: This axis stands for the craft's speed: forward for faster, back for slower. The screen does not show where the real control sits, so its place is a guess.
controls.context: On a stick and throttle set this is the throttle lever; in the work itself the pilot is mostly seen with both hands on the flight controls.
